SELECT o.ORDERNO AS orderNo, p.PROID AS proId, p.NAME AS productName, p.IMG1 AS productImg, oi.PRICE AS price, oi.QUANTITY AS quantity, (oi.PRICE * oi.QUANTITY) AS totalPrice, o.STATUS AS status, o.ORDEREDAT AS orderedAt, s.MEMID AS sellerId, ms.COMPANY AS sellerCompany, s.ADDRESSBASIC AS sellerAddress,
-- ✅ 상품 단위 상태 관리 oi.CONFIRM_YN AS confirmYn, oi.REVIEW_YN AS reviewYn, oi.EXCHANGE_YN AS exchangeYn, oi.RETURN_YN AS returnYn
FROM TB_ORDER o JOIN TB_ORDER_ITEM oi ON o.ORDERNO = oi.ORDERNO JOIN TB_PRODUCT p ON oi.PROID = p.PROID JOIN TB_MEMBER s ON p.MEMID = s.MEMID JOIN TB_MEMBER_SELLER ms ON s.MEMID = ms.MEMID WHERE o.MEMID = #{memId} ORDER BY o.ORDEREDAT DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

SELECT o.ORDERNO AS orderNo, TO_CHAR(o.ORDEREDAT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS orderedAt, o.STATUS AS status, o.PAYMETHOD AS payMethod, o.TOTALPRICE AS totalPrice, o.RECNAME AS recName, o.RECPHONE AS recPhone, o.RECZIPCODE AS recZipCode, o.RECADDRESSBASIC AS recAddressBasic, o.RECADDRESSDETAIL AS recAddressDetail, oi.ORDERITEMID AS orderItemId, oi.PROID AS proId, p.NAME AS productName, p.IMG1 AS productImg, oi.PRICE AS price, oi.QUANTITY AS quantity, oi.DISCOUNTRATE AS discountRate, oi.DELIVERYFEE AS deliveryFee FROM TB_ORDER o JOIN TB_ORDER_ITEM oi ON o.ORDERNO = oi.ORDERNO JOIN TB_PRODUCT p ON oi.PROID = p.PROID WHERE o.MEMID = #{memId} AND o.ORDERNO = #{orderNo} ORDER BY oi.ORDERITEMID

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT inner_query.*, ROWNUM AS rn FROM ( SELECT o.ORDERNO AS orderNo, oi.PROID AS proId, p.NAME AS productName, p.IMG1 AS productImg, oi.PRICE AS price, oi.QUANTITY AS quantity, (oi.PRICE * oi.QUANTITY) AS totalPrice, o.STATUS AS status, o.ORDEREDAT AS orderedAt, oi.CONFIRM_YN AS confirmYn, oi.REVIEW_YN AS reviewYn, oi.EXCHANGE_YN AS exchangeYn, oi.RETURN_YN AS returnYn FROM TB_ORDER o JOIN TB_ORDER_ITEM oi ON o.ORDERNO = oi.ORDERNO JOIN TB_PRODUCT p ON oi.PROID = p.PROID WHERE o.MEMID = #{memId} AND o.ORDEREDAT BETWEEN #{startDateTime} AND #{endDateTime} ORDER BY o.ORDEREDAT DESC, oi.ORDERITEMID DESC ) inner_query WHERE ROWNUM <= #{endRow} ) WHERE rn >= #{startRow} ORDER BY rn

SELECT m.MEMID AS sellerId, m.ROLE AS gradeName, s.COMPANY AS company, s.REPRESENTATIVE AS representative, s.TEL AS tel, s.FAX AS fax, s.BUSINESSNUMBER AS businessNumber, s.TIN AS tin, s.STATUS AS status, m.ZIPCODE AS zipCode, m.ADDRESSBASIC AS addressBasic, m.ADDRESSDETAIL AS addressDetail FROM TB_MEMBER m LEFT JOIN TB_MEMBER_SELLER s ON m.MEMID = s.MEMID WHERE m.MEMID = #{sellerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PRODUCT_REVIEW ( REVIEW_ID, PROID, MEMID, RATING, CONTENT, CREATED_AT, IMG1, IMG2, IMG3, ORDERNO ) VALUES ( SEQ_REVIEW_ID.NEXTVAL, #{proId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{memId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{rating, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{content, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, #{img1, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{img2, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{img3, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{orderNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT r.REVIEW_ID AS reviewId, r.PROID AS proId, r.MEMID AS memId, r.RATING AS rating, r.CONTENT AS content, r.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, r.IMG1 AS img1, r.IMG2 AS img2, r.IMG3 AS img3, r.ORDERNO AS orderNo, p.NAME AS productName FROM TB_PRODUCT_REVIEW r JOIN TB_PRODUCT p ON r.PROID = p.PROID WHERE r.MEMID = #{memId} ORDER BY r.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT r.REVIEW_ID AS reviewId, r.PROID AS proId, r.MEMID AS memId, r.RATING AS rating, r.CONTENT AS content, r.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, r.IMG1 AS img1, r.IMG2 AS img2, r.IMG3 AS img3, r.ORDERNO AS orderNo, p.NAME AS productName FROM TB_PRODUCT_REVIEW r JOIN TB_PRODUCT p ON r.PROID = p.PROID WHERE r.MEMID = #{memId} ORDER BY r.CREATED_AT DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT i.INQUIRY_ID AS inquiryId, i.CATEGORY1 AS type, i.TITLE AS title, i.STATUS AS status, i.ANSWER AS answer, i.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM TB_INQUIRY i WHERE i.WRITER = #{memId} ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT i.INQUIRY_ID AS inquiryId, i.CATEGORY1 AS type, i.TITLE AS title, i.STATUS AS status, i.ANSWER AS answer, i.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM TB_INQUIRY i WHERE i.WRITER = #{memId} ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT m.MEMID AS memId, g.NAME AS name, g.BIRTH AS birth, g.GENDER AS gender, g.EMAIL AS email, g.PHONE AS phone, g.STATUS AS status, g.NOTE AS note, g.LASTLOGIN AS lastLogin, m.JOINDATE AS joinDate, gr.GRADE AS grade, gr.DISCOUNTRATE AS discountRate, m.ZIPCODE AS zipCode, m.ADDRESSBASIC AS addressBasic, m.ADDRESSDETAIL AS addressDetail FROM TB_MEMBER m LEFT JOIN TB_MEMBER_GENERAL g ON m.MEMID = g.MEMID LEFT JOIN TB_GRADE gr ON m.MEMID = gr.MEMID WHERE m.MEMID = #{memId}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_MEMBER_GENERAL SET NAME = #{name}, BIRTH = #{birth, jdbcType=DATE}, GENDER = #{gender}, EMAIL = #{email}, PHONE = #{phone} WHERE MEMID = #{memId}
